evidence.notes: Visualforce page tokens resolve to local PageReference values.
Observed controller save/getId behavior works against local SObject DML.
Observed list pagination helpers work for local record lists.
Observed no-render data category selection accepts group and category names.
Observed constructors and getters/setters are supported.

source.content: public class RuntimeVisualforceController { private ApexPages.StandardController controller; public RuntimeVisualforceController(ApexPages.StandardController controller) { this.controller = controller; } public PageReference save() { return controller.save(); } public List<SelectOption> getOptions() { SelectOption option = new SelectOption('1', 'One', true, false); option.setLabel('Changed'); return new List<SelectOption>{option}; } }

@isTest private class VisualforceControllerRuntimeTest { @isTest static void controllerAndUiValueRuntime() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'VF'); ApexPages.StandardController std = new ApexPages.StandardController(account); PageReference saved = std.save(); System.assertEquals(account.Id, std.getId()); System.assertEquals('/' + account.Id, saved.getUrl()); System.assertEquals('/apex/MyPage', Page.MyPage.getUrl()); SelectOption option = new SelectOption('1', 'One', true, false); option.setLabel('Changed'); System.assertEquals('1', option.getValue()); System.assertEquals('Changed', option.getLabel()); System.assert(option.getDisabled()); System.assertEquals(false, option.getEscapeItem()); ApexPages.StandardSetController setController = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>{account, new Account(Name = 'Second')}); setController.setPageSize(1); System.assertEquals(1, setController.getRecords().size()); System.assert(setController.getHasNext()); setController.next(); System.assertEquals(2, setController.getPageNumber()); System.assert(setController.getHasPrevious()); } @isTest static void knowledgeArticleCategorySelectionIsNoRender() { Knowledge__kav article = new Knowledge__kav(Title = 'Local article'); ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController controller = new ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController(article); controller.setDataCategory('Products', 'Hardware'); System.assertEquals(null, controller.getSourceId()); } }
